title: Validate χ2 heat CI and couple both χ1/χ2–SM Pauli channels to Yukawa Bose source and finite SM
objective: For original real φ neutral U1' and vectorlike χ1χ2 with equal nonzero gauge charge, χ2–SM vector channel is unavoidable. A conditional finite-mV full-Pauli 5D heat scan with m1=.1me,m2=.02me,Tχ=.09me,Te=Tν=.1me shows Qχ2/Qχ1 ~1.28 for two active ν at nrad/nmu6..10, and ~1.07-1.08 for e±; daughter heat is not automatically negligible. But these are independently prescribed thermal FD occupancies, not actual χ2 produced f or physical UV. Verify new CI; build full χ2e/χν strong collision kernels with real evolving fχ2 and exact finite SM heat/entropy/charges, coupled simultaneously to χ1↔χ2+φ Bose/Pauli with physical mediator/gauge charges. Independently validate q/dt/cutoff, no phenomenological BGK Γel or 86eV ΩDM claims.
